**Please don't open pull requests here.**

Your task lives on the `devyai-task-<code>` branch of **your own fork**. Devy finds it there by its token in `.devy/task.json`; nothing needs to be merged into this repo. This pull request will be closed automatically.

When you're done, set `"status": "done"` in `.devy/task.json` on your branch and push, or tap **I'm done** in Devy.
